LocalRun — rebuild and run only what matters locally: scan repositories,
track dependency graphs and repack components to a local NuGet source.

Usage: lrun <command> [options]

Relative paths are resolved against the current directory.
Exit codes: 0 success, also when there was nothing to do; 1 the command failed (anything the codes below don't cover); 2
invalid command line; 3 an input is missing or invalid: a config file, the root to scan, the settings; 4 a dotnet
command failed: fix the code or the project, retrying won't help; 5 refused by --strict; 6 verify found a package
missing or stale.

Every command also takes:
  --json                        Write one JSON document on stdout (result, warnings and errors, files written), even
                                when it fails; the logs go to stderr, plain.
  --strict                      Fail (exit code 5) when the result left something out or may have a wrong version: name
                                collisions, cycles, MSBuild or NuGet source failures... The files are written all the
                                same.
  --log-level <level>           Least important logs to print: Trace, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, Critical, None
                                (default: your settings, else Information). Debug adds timings and the stack trace of a
                                failure.

Commands:

  build [options]
      Scan a directory tree for projects and write their dependency graph to a config file.
      Options:
        --root <dir>            Directory to scan (default: your settings, else current directory).
        --local-nuget <dir>     Local NuGet feed to repack into (default: your settings, else ~/.localnuget).
        --config <file>         Config file to write (default: .lrun/localrun.config.json).
        --users-of <names>      Keep the given projects and all that depend on them, transitively.
        --deps-of <names>       Keep the given projects and all they depend on, transitively. With --users-of too: only
       
[truncated]
